lines: Over the last 2 years, the Pranab Mukherjee Scholarship Examination (PMSE) has changed the lives
of more than 20,000 students across West Bengal and beyond. Many of them have received
scholarships, medals, and certificates, and most importantly, they have secured admission into
top colleges and universities under the Techno India Group and other reputed institutions.
PMSE is not just another exam — it is a gateway to fulfilling your dreams. It helps students
from all backgrounds, especially those with strong talent but limited financial resources, to
take a big step toward a bright future.

This scholarship examination offers a unique and golden opportunity for candidates appearing in
, XII Examination and equivalent Examination in 2026. They have the privilege
of participating in an online examination featuring multiple-choice questions (MCQs). This
examination not only opens the doors to potential scholarships of up to 100% but also promises a
plethora of other prestigious prizes. Additionally, successful candidates are assured of gaining
admission to colleges and universities of TIG.
The primary objective of this pioneering scholarship examination program is to provide essential
support to exceptionally talented yet financially disadvantaged students, enabling them to
achieve the success they have always aspired to attain, showcasing their overall merit. Many
promising young individuals, hailing from remote rural areas to bustling cities, remain unaware
of the diverse academic offerings available at Techno India Group colleges, encompassing
Science, Arts, and Commerce streams for both the 10th and 10+2 levels. This initiative aims to
raise awareness among these students, offering them a spectrum of choices to chart their career
path according to their true passions.
Students who secure scholarships will have the opportunity to pursue their desired courses at
various TIG colleges. By undergoing this examination and subsequently earning scholarships,
students not only reignite their enthusiasm for academic excellence but also alleviate the
financial burdens that may hinder their educational pursuits. Moreover, it fosters healthy
competition among them, equipping them to excel in various spheres of life in the future.

delivering quality education in science and engineering in the state of West Bengal, India.
Techno India presently stands as one of the most recognized leaders among private education
groups in India by virtue of its academic excellence and vast multitude of course offerings.
Techno India Group is one of the largest and most acclaimed knowledge management groups in Asia.
